statistics.model_objective: Objective returned by the model; not the input column used for statistical summaries
statistics.paired_unit: instance_index within method, kappa, size and decode, paired to the ID mechanism
statistics.paper_aggregation: equal mean across the four size/kappa cells; mean across six OOD mechanisms for the overall row
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over five Co-HeT-versus-baseline comparisons within each kappa/size/mechanism/decode setting
statistics.effect: matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation of baseline minus Co-HeT; positive favors Co-HeT
